$description: ElevenMusic public surface, measured 2026-11-21 from elevenmusic.io in headless Chromium. Dark is the live default (html.dark). Light was applied by adding html.light, setting data-theme=light, and clicking Light theme. Colours are CSS lab() readings converted to sRGB. Pill radii that computed as 3.35544e+07px are recorded as 9999px.
